name: bodyweight walking calf raise
description: Walk forward staying high on your toes with every step. It builds calf endurance and ankle control without any equipment.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Take a step forward, staying on your toes.
Keep alternating steps without dropping your heels.
Lower your heels when you reach the end of the set.
